records.gen_sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(i.unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY avg_unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: 各区域已支付订单的明细行数？
records.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, COUNT(i.id) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_no=i.order_no WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

records.question: 华东区域的订单占全部订单的比例（百分比）？

records.question: 已发货订单中各类目的销售金额占比？
